mapper.select: SELECT FROM sr_english_listening_segment s JOIN sr_english_listening_item i ON i.id=s.listening_item_id WHERE i.slug=#{slug} AND i.publish_status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY s.sort_order,s.start_ms,s.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sr_english_listening_segment WHERE id=#{segmentId} AND listening_item_id=#{itemId}
